dct_description_sm: Myanmar national river network (polylines). Place names from General Administration Department (GAD) with transliteration by MIMU. Polylines by MIMU based on the Digital Chart of the World. This dataset was mainly digitized at 1:1,000,000 scale. Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the government concerned.
